name: Screen Tabs
description: A row of big buttons to jump between screens — Home, each person, Planning, Shopping, News.
author: tweetyboopdev2022-code

defaultConfig.tabs: Home, Alex, Sam, Jordan, Planning, Shopping, News
defaultConfig.colors: Home:#f5c37e, Alex:#34d399, Sam:#f472b6, Jordan:#fbbf24, Planning:#60a5fa, Shopping:#4ade80, News:#fb923c

tabs.title: Tabs (screen names, in order)
tabs.description: Comma-separated. Matches the start of each screen's name. Leave empty for an invisible block that only hides the dots.

current.title: This screen
current.description: Which tab to highlight here, e.g. Sam.

hideDots.title: Hide the page dots
hideDots.description: The small dots at the bottom of the wall do the same job and also reach hidden screens like Guests.

scrollLists.title: Make Todoist lists scrollable
scrollLists.description: Long to-do lists scroll with a finger instead of being cut off.
